summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Super Micro Computer, Inc. for a follow-on public offering of 45,454,545 shares of common stock at $27.50 per share, with an overallotment option of 6,818,181 shares, aiming to raise approximately $1.25 billion. Concurrently, the company is also offering 75,000,000 depositary shares representing mandatory convertible preferred stock and has an ATM program for up to $1.25 billion. Proceeds are intended to fund component purchases for approximately $39 billion of AI server orders and general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and others, with expected delivery on June 12, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
